store.title: Open the Chrome Web Store
store.body: Click the button below to open the official VidGrab listing on the Chrome Web Store.

confirm.title: Add the extension
confirm.body: Click Add to Chrome and confirm with Add extension — your browser will automatically keep VidGrab up to date.

pin.title: Pin it to your toolbar
pin.body: Click the puzzle icon in your browser toolbar, then click the pin icon next to VidGrab for one-click downloads on any page.

heroSub: Download videos in one click right on TikTok, Douyin, Facebook, Instagram, X & HLS players — via Chrome Web Store or the latest v5.29.2 .ZIP package.
download: Add to Chrome — Chrome Web Store
downloadZipHint: The v5.29.2 .ZIP build includes every latest feature (Floating Hover Pill, Multi-Audio, OPFS HLS). Enable Developer Mode at chrome://extensions and drop the ZIP.
otherBrowsers: Works seamlessly on Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Cốc Cốc and Brave — just open the Chrome Web Store link in your browser and click Add to Chrome.

sniff.title: Catches the videos a page plays
sniff.body: Lists the videos a page is playing (MP4, HLS). Downloads MP4 and HLS streams right in your browser and joins them into one MP4 file.

channel.title: Scans whole channels — stop any time
channel.body: Open a Douyin, TikTok or Facebook Reels channel and the extension scrolls it to collect the videos. Press Stop scan when you have enough.

list.title: Pick many videos, download them in one go
list.body: See the thumbnail and title of every collected video, tick the ones you want (or all of them, or the first 10) and download them to your computer in one go. The extension downloads them on your machine and keeps going with the popup closed, no website needed.

local.title: Downloads on your own device
local.body: Downloads happen in your browser or app first; VidGrab's server only steps in when that is not possible.

app.title: Works with the VidGrab Windows app
app.body: Streams with separate video and audio (DASH) are handed to the VidGrab Windows app on your PC, which downloads and merges them locally.

drm.title: Tells you which videos can't be downloaded
drm.body: DRM-protected, encrypted or live videos are clearly marked; the extension does not try to download them.
